info.title: Ranger API
info.description: Ranger backend v1 contract: every declared frontend operation across all route families. Routes whose provider is not yet implemented return an explicit not_configured (501) envelope — never fake success.

families.description: Credentials and sessions (API tokens, browser sessions, connection tickets)
Projects, memberships and the customer-configurable engineer display name
Conversations, messages, questions, answers and requirement/decision versions
Project event subscription and cursor replay (HTTP plus WebSocket)
Voice sessions and the secure xAI realtime relay
Capture sessions, frame ingestion, inspection and retained evidence
Engineering runs: start, status and cancel. Pause and resume are rejected as unsupported
Workspace create, status, files, commands, logs, diffs, artifacts, screenshots and cleanup
Authenticated desktop stream sessions and private application previews
Project-scoped Trace retrieval and the labeled fallback
